Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring the department of fish and wildlife to draft a grey wolf management plan.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to grey wolf management; and creating a newsection.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The department of fish and wildlife, usingexisting resources and personnel, shall develop a draft grey wolfmanagement plan and present the plan to the legislature by December 31,2006. The department of fish and wildlife shall hold a public hearingon the draft plan in each of the department's regions prior totransmitting the report to the legislature.
